Name: Cooking Overhaul
Author: stardemod
Description:
Tired of cooking up culinary delights only to find their selling price pales in comparison to the cost of their ingredients? Say goodbye to kitchen woes with our mod! By dynamically adjusting the selling price of your cooked dishes based on the value of their ingredients, cooking becomes a financially rewarding endeavor. With an adjustable sale price modifier allowing you to fine-tune your profit margins, turn your culinary creations into lucrative investments. Cook with confidence, knowing that every dish you serve up is not only delicious but also a smart financial choice!

[b]Details:
[/b][list]
[*]All cooked dishes are profitable
[*]Cooked dishes can have quality, depending on the quality of the ingredients
[*]Qi Seasoning increases quality by 2 levels instead of just setting it to Gold
[*]Recipes that require an ingredient category, like Sashimi, calculate the dish's price based on the ingredients used
[/list]
[b]Example Calculation:
[/b]A Fried Egg cooked with an Iridium Quality Duck Egg calculates the price as follows:

190g (Price of Iridium Quality Duck Egg)
* 1.2 (SaleModifier: Skill Rancher +20%)
* 1.2 (configurable SalePriceModifier in the mod's config, default is 20%)
* 2 (Dish quality will be Iridium Quality because the ingredient is Iridium Quality)
= 547g (old price: 35g)

[b]Profit:
[/b]Sale price of Iridium Quality Duck Egg with Rancher skill: 228g
That's an increase in profit of 319g through cooking. (Old profit margin was -193g)

[b]Quality:
[/b]The quality of the dish is calculated based on the average quality of the ingredients. If Qi Seasoning is used, the dish's quality increases by an additional 2 levels.

With all these changes, you can finally turn your Iridium Quality Legend into Sashimi and make a substantial profit.
